Silica Carat is a bodyguard of the UFS.



Personality
She is fearless and smug about her greater strength. She talks in a rather casual, harsh tone and provokes her enemies even when in a disadvantage.

Furthermore, she is observant and checks for weakness or escape routes, while doing so. Silica is loyal and thankful to the UFS for taking her out of the slums.

Appearance
She has short blond hair and green eyes.

History
Background
She was born on the streets of the UFS, and had a harsh life until the UFS picked her up, for her naturally high physical abilities.

Although she was originally a rough character, she feels indebted to the United States for picking him up, and will take on dirty jobs if it means doing so. Since being picked up, she has also participated in special mission training, further enhancing his physical abilities. Her main duties are guarding, and she mainly lures attackers into a false sense of security by disguising herself as an ordinary person. She is now able to subdue any number of people in a street fight. She is good at close-quarters combat, making the most of her physical abilities, and has been issued a Micro Breaker to deal with Taimanin and demons. Thanks to this weapon, she has become famous in some circles as a guard who can launch invisible attacks. She believes she can fight well enough without using weapons, but she is afraid of failing because of this and losing her place again, so she tries to use all the power she has.

Timeline TABA
Appears only in a "what if" event.

Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Gauntlets

Shockwave: Her gauntlets can cast shockwaves called "Micro Breaker" also known as invisible fists. Crushes anything at the point where the high frequency waves generated by the devices on both arms cross each other. It is also possible to generate high frequency waves by covering only one arm, in which case there is no need to cross the arms.
Excellent Athletic Abilities
